news.title: Oxygen delivery on display
news.summary_en: Biomedical researchers at WashU McKelvey Engineering have developed a new imaging technique that captures the dynamic coupling between the brain’s vasculature and its neurons. The new microscopy tool could help lead to breakthroughs in studying stroke and dementia.

news.title: Why are refugees with jobs still living in poverty?
news.summary_en: For newly resettled refugees in the United States, getting a job doesn’t always mean escaping poverty, says an expert on migration policy at Washington University in St. Louis.

news.title: AI Perspectives Week showcases AI innovation, debate and discovery
news.summary_en: WashU’s AI Perspectives Week will feature about 40 events, showcasing faculty, students and leading thinkers on artificial intelligence. The series highlights research, teaching, ethics and community dialogue, while welcoming both enthusiasts and skeptics.

news.title: Alberti campers sketch, build and dream big
news.summary_en: Launched in 2007, WashU’s Alberti Program offers young people a hands-on introduction to architecture, a field rarely included in the K-12 curriculum. Students ask the same questions, use the same tools and build the same models as real-life architects.

news.title: Waterlogged seeds reveal melons’ ancient journey
news.summary_en: A new WashU study shows how scientists can use ancient DNA to answer historical questions beyond what artifacts alone can reveal.
